title: footprint.blast_radius 1.1.0
description: The export-surface diff of a footprint run: the exported symbols added, removed and signature-changed between the compared refs, each with the call sites of its name. The symbols come from graft's CLI contract `graft struct exports --json` (`graft.cli.struct_exports` 1.0.0); footprint derives the counts, the ordering, and the call sites. The call sites are footprint's own conservative whole-word identifier scan of the tracked files of the working tree -- no graft contract answers with a call site's line -- so they include the declaration itself and a mention in a comment, a string or prose, and they cannot see a call through dynamic dispatch or a re-export under another name. When graft is unavailable the section is stated as unavailable with a reason, never omitted; the same holds for the scan.

range.description: The git range compared, as given to git diff

available.description: False when graft could not be resolved, failed, or answered under a contract version footprint does not read

reason.description: Present when available is false: why the export surface could not be read

code.description: graft.not_resolved: no graft binary. graft.exports_failed: the subcommand exited non-zero. graft.output_unreadable: the answer was not JSON footprint could read. graft.schema_mismatch: a different _schema id or version. range.unresolved: the base of a three-dot range had no merge base.

detail.description: What happened, in enough words to act on

base.description: The base ref passed to graft: the merge base for a three-dot range, the given base otherwise

head.description: The head ref passed to graft

added.description: Exported symbols present at head and absent at base

removed.description: Exported symbols present at base and absent at head

signature_changed.description: Exported symbols present at both ends whose signature differs; each carries previous_signature when graft reported one

counts.description: The length of each list, so a reader needs no arithmetic; computed from the lists and nothing else

call_sites.description: Every symbol's call sites added up. Present only when the scan ran: a count of call sites nobody looked for is not a figure.

semver_impact.description: graft's own semver judgement for the surface change, passed through verbatim; null when graft reported none. footprint does not derive it.

call_site_scan.description: How the call sites on the symbols above were found, or why they were not. `method` is `identifier_scan`: every whole-word occurrence of the symbol's name in a tracked, non-binary file of the working tree, where a word character is a letter, a digit or an underscore in any script (`[\p{L}\p{N}_]`) on both sides -- `grep -w`'s own rule, which is what makes the independent grep oracle in footprint's test suite exact for an ASCII symbol name. When `available` is false no symbol carries `call_sites` at all, so a scan that did not run can never be read as one that found nothing.

files_skipped.description: Tracked files the scan did not match, each for a stated reason

binary.description: Files holding a NUL byte in their first 8192, skipped exactly as `grep -I` skips them

unreadable.description: Tracked files that could not be read, a file deleted from the working tree among them

reason.description: Present when available is false: why there are no call sites to show

code.description: scan.not_run: no scan was attached to this surface, so no tree was read. scan.ls_files_failed: `git ls-files -z` exited non-zero, so there was no file list to scan.

contract.description: The graft CLI contract that answered, so a reader knows which interface produced the list

allOf.description: A scan that ran lists every symbol's call sites, empty included: a symbol nothing references is never dropped, and the total is reported.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of range and exports (spec §7.1)

symbol.description: The exported symbol's name, as graft reported it

file.description: The file the symbol is exported from, repository-relative

kind.description: graft's kind for the symbol (function, interface, field, export, ...); graft's vocabulary, not footprint's

signature.description: The signature at head, verbatim from graft, newlines and all

previous_signature.description: The signature at base, present only on a signature change graft reported one for

call_sites.description: Where the symbol's name occurs as a whole word in the tracked, non-binary files of the working tree, ordered by file then line, one entry per line however many times it occurs on that line. Empty means the scan found none, which is reported rather than dropped; absent means no scan ran, which `call_site_scan.reason` states.

file.description: Repository-relative path, as `git ls-files` printed it

line.description: 1-based line number, as `grep -n` would print it
